result.instructions: Tools for DealHub, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which quotes are linked to the Acme opportunity in our CRM, and what is each one's status?"; "Who signed the contract in the DealRoom for opportunity OPP-2025-0412, and when?"; "List our active DealHub versions and show the user for login jane.doe@acme.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes DealHub data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run dealhub_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dealhub_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dealhub_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. dealhub_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dealhub_get_quote
tools.title: Get a quote
tools.description: Get one DealHub quote by its DealHub quote id, with the detail sections you ask for (info, summary, deal_room_info, line_items, answers, approvals, all). A draft with quote_upgrade_required=true returns no detail until someone saves it in the DealHub UI. DealHub: GET /api/v2/quote/{quote_id}.

features.description: Quote detail to return: info, summary, deal_room_info, line_items, answers, approvals, or all. Without it the response holds only id, status and quote_upgrade_required.

external_identifier.description: True when quote_id is the CRM's external quote id, not the DealHub id.

tools.name: dealhub_list_quotes
tools.title: List quotes
tools.description: List DealHub quotes, optionally only those linked to one CRM opportunity. Returns 50 at most per page; more_results_matching_the_request says when to page on with offset. Avoid detail features on a full history sweep: they make large, slow responses. DealHub: GET /api/v2/quotes.

external_opportunity_id.description: CRM opportunity id to filter by (e.g. the Salesforce or HubSpot id).

features.description: Quote detail to return: info, summary, deal_room_info, line_items, answers, approvals, or all. Without it the response holds only id, status and quote_upgrade_required.

tools.name: dealhub_get_dealroom_signers
tools.title: Get DealRoom signers
tools.description: Get who signed a contract in the DealRoom for a CRM opportunity: the DealRoom state, and the buyer and seller signers with names, titles and signature dates. DealHub: GET /api/v1/dealroom/{opportunity_id}.

tools.name: dealhub_list_versions
tools.title: List versions
tools.description: List DealHub versions (the configuration that holds products, pricing and playbooks), optionally by status. The active version is the one quotes use. DealHub: GET /api/v1/versions.

tools.name: dealhub_get_version
tools.title: Get a version
tools.description: Get one DealHub version by its DealHub version id. DealHub: GET /api/v1/version/id/{version_id}.

tools.name: dealhub_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List DealHub users (sales reps, managers, admins), optionally only active or inactive ones. Passwords and tokens are never returned. DealHub: GET /api/v1/users.

tools.name: dealhub_get_user_by_login
tools.title: Get a user by login
tools.description: Get one DealHub user by login name (the unique, immutable login of the user). DealHub: GET /api/v1/user/login/{login}.

tools.name: dealhub_get_user_by_id
tools.title: Get a user by id
tools.description: Get one DealHub user by DealHub user id. DealHub: GET /api/v1/user/id/{id}.

tools.name: dealhub_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create an opportunity
tools.description: Create a DealHub opportunity from a CRM opportunity, for example to start a renewal quote. Needs the CRM opportunity id, its owner (external_user_id, email, name), the currency and the customer. This writes a record in DealHub; the API error text says if the create fails. DealHub: POST /api/v1/opportunity.

external_opportunity_id.description: CRM opportunity id (unique in the CRM).

external_opportunity_name.description: Opportunity name as shown in the CRM.

prompts.name: getting_started

prompts.description: What you can do with DealHub here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_quotes_for_a_crm_opportunity

prompts.name: check_who_signed_a_dealroom_contract
prompts.title: Check who signed a DealRoom contract
prompts.description: Read the DealRoom state and the buyer and seller signers for a CRM opportunity, with their signature dates.

prompts.name: review_versions

prompts.description: List the versions by status, or open one version by id. The active version is the one that quotes use.

prompts.name: look_up_users
prompts.title: Look up users
prompts.description: List users, or open one user by login or by id. Passwords and tokens are never returned.

prompts.name: create_an_opportunity_for_a_renewal

prompts.description: Create a DealHub opportunity from a CRM opportunity, with its owner, currency and customer. The record is written in DealHub.
